notes.title: Update: Performance Improvement
notes.content: [p]This update focuses on [b]performance improvements[/b] for a smoother experience in both single- and multiplayer. Also includes a few small bug fixes.[/p]

notes.title: Update: Multiplayer
notes.content:
[h1]Time to play with friends![/h1] Multiplayer is now live and you can jump in with up to [b]8 players[/b]! Get ready for some epic building and combat on a whole new scale. Face off against your mates or ally with them to take on the AI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324383/205ff982c90880d508189a92efa4fb42ed1f7523.png[/img]

Looking ahead, I'm working on some new features to make playing together even better. For example markers/pings for easier communication with your allies, a public server browser to find games and cross-play! So you can strategize and clash with even more players, no matter their platform.

I'm excited about the future of "Settle and Battle: New Empires" and can't wait for your feedback and ideas!

notes.title: Update: New Tribe - Mongols
notes.content:
Among their unique structures are the Yak Field and Arkhi Distillery. Command powerful longbow units and test your skills in three brand-new missions. Experience their nomadic playstyle and conquer the land! Available now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324383/056269a1001b4c57eac2925f280eada03a9954dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Update: Resource Transport Prioritization
notes.content:
A new Transport Priority panel has been added. This feature allows you to reorder which resources your settlers prioritize transporting, giving you greater control over your empire's development. These settings are saved per savegame. Quickly adapt to different strategies with the three available presets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324383/04c1b56d038a66fad602b56832fdecb0e7d644c4.png[/img]

Military: Prioritizes resources needed for soldier recruitment.
Settlers: Boosts settler reproduction by prioritizing relevant resources.
Construction: Focuses on building materials like planks, clay, bricks and wood.

For a future update it is planned to save and load your custom made presets.
